name: Guard Berton
summary: Outside the Lakeshire Inn, Guard Berton seeks swift justice for Targorr the Dread. The human guardsman is tired of Stormwind's delays while Redridge faces the Blackrock orc invasion.

sections.title: A Guard Seeking Justice
sections.body: Guard Berton keeps watch outside the Lakeshire Inn as Redridge Mountains faces the Blackrock orc invasion. His concern is Targorr the Dread, an enemy captured and locked deep within the Stormwind Stockade. Sentenced to death for crimes against the kingdom, Targorr remains imprisoned because Stormwind has postponed his execution indefinitely. Berton will not let the brutal raider linger in a cell while Lakeshire bleeds. He hires willing adventurers to bypass the delays and kill the orc.

faq.answer: Guard Berton is an Alliance guard posted outside the Lakeshire Inn in Redridge Mountains. He hires adventurers to carry out justice against an infamous orc prisoner.

faq.q: Why does Guard Berton want Targorr the Dread killed?
faq.answer: Stormwind has put Targorr the Dread's execution on hold, despite his sentence for crimes against the kingdom. With Redridge under siege, Berton arranges for Targorr to be killed inside the Stockade.

faq.q: Where is Targorr the Dread held?
faq.answer: Targorr the Dread is held in the Stockade, a high-security dungeon in Stormwind City's Canal district.

faq.q: Where can Guard Berton be found?
faq.answer: Guard Berton keeps watch just outside the Lakeshire Inn, overlooking Lakeshire's town center in Redridge.

angles.text: As an Alliance defender, you can see why border towns grow frustrated when Stormwind's bureaucracy delays justice while they fight for survival.
